user.title: Irrigation Controller
user.description: Connect to irrigationd. The token is the IRRIGATIOND_TOKEN value on the irrigationd host.

error.invalid_host: The host can't contain spaces or control characters.

data.master_zone: Master valve or pump zone (0 for none)

data_description.token: Leave blank to keep the current token.
data_description.master_zone: An irrigationd zone that opens with every other zone, such as a master valve or pump relay. It can't be run on its own.
data_description.master_switch: Optional. A Home Assistant switch that turns on with every zone. It has no timer of its own, so prefer a zone if you can.
data_description.master_lead: How long the master opens before each zone.
